- Cody walks, Hank jogs, Rose lopes round the horse trail, now and then (the game decides when).

- Coach Ieva and Coach Stan at the jump field: point at the jumps, blow the whistle, cheer.
- Where they stand and the trail path: Map chat (row living-20261030-riders-map).
